This 2022 GMC Yukon XL AT4 in Black vehicle highlights include premium features designed for those who demand capability and refinement in a full-size SUV.

- Second row power bucket seats with power release
- Power-retractable assist steps with perimeter lighting
- Dual-pane power panoramic sunroof with express-open and close
- EcoTec3 6.2L V8 engine with 420 hp and 460 lb-ft of torque
- 10-speed automatic transmission with overdrive and 4WD
- Bose 9-speaker audio system with SiriusXM 360L
- Heated and ventilated front seats with memory positioning
- Magnetic Ride Control adaptive suspension
- Front and rear park assist with rear cross traffic alert
- Automatic emergency braking with forward collision alert

- Navigation system with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility
- Wireless charging and heated steering wheel
- 3rd row 60/40 power-folding split-bench seat
- 20-inch machined aluminum wheels

The AT4 trim delivers a commanding presence on the road while maintaining comfort for all passengers. With seating for up to eight, this SUV provides flexibility for family trips, weekend adventures, or business needs. The heated and ventilated front seats adjust to memory settings, ensuring your preferred driving position is always available. Power-folding third-row seating maximizes cargo space when needed, and the power liftgate makes loading convenient.

Advanced technology is seamlessly integrated throughout the cabin. The navigation system connects with your smartphone via Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, keeping you informed and connected. The Bose audio system with SiriusXM 360L transforms your daily commute into an enjoyable experience. Wireless charging and dual-zone automatic climate control demonstrate the attention to detail in every feature.

Safety features work behind the scenes to help protect you and your passengers. Automatic emergency braking, forward collision alert, and lane keep assist provide active protection on highways and city streets alike. Front and rear park assist sensors guide you into tight spaces, while the rear cross traffic alert watches your back when reversing. The comprehensive airbag system and stability control technologies are engineered to respond when needed most.

The 6.2L V8 engine delivers substantial power with 420 horsepower and 460 lb-ft of torque, paired with a 10-speed automatic transmission and 4WD capability. The Magnetic Ride Control suspension adapts to road conditions, while front and rear parking sensors and hill descent control enhance your control in any situation. Combined with the 3.23 rear axle ratio, this Yukon XL handles towing and hauling with confidence.

This 2022 Yukon XL AT4 represents a well-equipped full-size SUV ready for your next chapter, whether that's family adventures or daily versatility.

Hill descent control provides additional confidence on challenging descents, while the heavy-duty air filter protects the engine during demanding conditions. The all-terrain tires and protective skid plates complete a package built for serious work and adventure.

This 2023 Ford Mustang Mach-E Premium combines sophisticated design with practical electric performance, offering a capable vehicle for today's driving needs.

The blue exterior presents a clean, modern appearance that stands out on the road. Inside, you'll find thoughtfully designed comfort features including heated front bucket seats and an overhead console that organizes your essentials. The power-adjustable driver seat with memory functionality allows you to customize your driving position, while the heated steering wheel adds comfort during colder months. Climate control is handled through automatic temperature management with front dual zones, ensuring every passenger remains comfortable.

Technology integration is straightforward and user-friendly. The SYNC 4A system with enhanced voice recognition gives you hands-free control, while the connected navigation system keeps you on course. Both Apple CarPlay and Android Auto are available, so your smartphone integrates seamlessly into the driving experience. The 10-speaker audio system with SiriusXM 360L delivers quality sound throughout the cabin.

Performance is efficient with an EPA-estimated 99 MPGe in the city and 86 MPGe on the highway, allowing you to travel farther on each charge. The dual electric motors provide responsive handling through the four-wheel independent suspension and speed-sensing steering system. Safety is prioritized with multiple airbags, electronic stability control, traction control, and a comprehensive brake assist system.

This vehicle includes comprehensive Ford Gold Certification benefits designed to give you confidence in your purchase:

- 172 Point Inspection
- Roadside Assistance

The mobile power cord allows flexible charging options at both 120V and 240V outlets, giving you convenience whether at home or away. This 2008 Honda CR-V EX-L offers a dependable foundation for your daily driving needs with a 2.4L I4 engine, 5-speed automatic transmission, and all-wheel drive capability.

- 7 Speakers with XM Satellite Radio and CD player
- Front dual zone automatic temperature control
- Heated reclining front bucket seats with leather trim
- Power moonroof
- Power driver seat with armrest and heated functionality
- Alloy wheels with all-season capability
- Remote keyless entry and security system
- Electronic Stability Control and traction control
- Speed-sensing steering and power steering
- Dual front and side impact airbags with anti-whiplash front head restraints
- Four-wheel independent suspension with front and rear anti-roll bars
- 4-wheel disc brakes with ABS
- Telescoping and tilt steering wheel with audio controls
- Split-folding rear seat for flexible cargo space

The CR-V's spacious interior combines practicality with comfort. The leather-appointed seating, heated front row, and split-folding rear seat provide flexibility whether you're carrying passengers or cargo. Dual-zone climate control ensures everyone rides comfortably, while the built-in XM satellite radio and seven-speaker audio system keep you entertained on every journey.

Safety and handling remain central to this vehicle's design. Four-wheel independent suspension, speed-sensing steering, and an array of modern safety features including Electronic Stability Control, traction control, and multiple airbags work together to provide confidence on any road condition.

The all-wheel drive system paired with the capable 2.4-liter engine delivers the balance of efficiency and capability that defines this generation. With an EPA rating of 20 city and 26 highway miles per gallon, this CR-V manages real-world driving without excessive fuel consumption.

The exterior presents in a distinctive green finish, while practical features like the power moonroof, rear window wiper with variable intermittent settings, and heated power mirrors demonstrate Honda's attention to user-friendly details.

This 2008 CR-V EX-L represents a solid choice for those seeking a dependable, well-equipped SUV that combines safety, comfort, and practical functionality for everyday driving.

- Duratec 3.5L V6 engine with 6-speed automatic transmission
- Front-wheel drive for improved traction and stability

The silver exterior presents a clean, professional appearance that suits both professional and personal use. Inside, the sedan features cloth bucket seats with front center armrest and split-folding rear seating, providing flexible interior space for passengers and cargo. The variably intermittent wipers adapt to weather conditions, and front fog lights improve visibility in challenging conditions.

The interior climate is easily managed through the air conditioning system, while illuminated entry lighting and front and rear reading lights ensure visibility throughout the cabin. The tilt steering wheel accommodates various driver preferences, and the trip computer provides useful driving information at a glance.

description:
This 2014 Hyundai Santa Fe Sport Base in brown offers a practical and well-equipped option for buyers seeking reliable crossover transportation with meaningful comfort features.

- Panoramic glass one-touch open sunroof
- Navigation system with 8 color touchscreen and rearview camera
- Heated front and rear seats with ventilated front seats
- Blind spot detection system
- Rear parking assistance system
- Power driver seat with 4-way lumbar control
- Heated steering wheel
- Leather-wrapped steering wheel and shift knob
- Dual zone automatic temperature control
- Fog lights and automatic headlight control
- SiriusXM satellite radio with premium audio system
- Proximity key entry with push button start
- Roof side rails

The Santa Fe Sport is built on a platform designed for everyday versatility. Its 2.4L four-cylinder engine paired with a six-speed automatic transmission with Shiftronic capability and overdrive delivers fuel efficiency rated at 20 city and 27 highway mpg, making it reasonable for both daily commuting and longer drives.

Inside, the cabin reflects a thoughtful approach to comfort and convenience. The multi-adjustable front bucket seats with heating and ventilation work alongside sliding and reclining second-row seats to accommodate various passenger configurations. The heated rear seats extend comfort to back-seat occupants during colder months. The leather-wrapped steering wheel and shift knob provide a premium feel at key touch points throughout your drive.

Technology integration centers on the navigation system with its eight-inch color touchscreen display, which includes a rearview camera for easier parking maneuvers. The audio system features AM/FM, SiriusXM satellite radio, and CD capability, with Bluetooth connectivity for hands-free phone operation. Blue Link telematics adds an extra layer of connected vehicle functionality.

Safety features include blind spot detection, rear parking assistance, electronic stability control, traction control, and a comprehensive airbag system. The four-wheel independent suspension with speed-sensing steering contributes to responsive handling dynamics on various road conditions.

This Santa Fe Sport represents a capable crossover that balances everyday practicality with comfort amenities. We invite you to schedule a showing and experience how this vehicle aligns with your driving needs and lifestyle requirements.

Discover the commanding presence of the 2027 Ford Expedition Platinum, a full-size SUV engineered to deliver both capability and refined comfort for those who demand excellence.

- 3.5L V6 EcoBoost High Output Engine with auto start-stop technology
- Stealth Performance Package with aggressive styling and premium finishes
- Power Panoramic Vista Roof with power shade for enhanced interior light
- B&O Play Unleashed sound system with 22 speakers and customizable audio profiles
- Ford Co-Pilot360 Active 2.0 advanced driver assistance technology
- Heavy-Duty Trailer Tow with integrated trailer brake control
- 24" ebony painted aluminum wheels with performance tires
- Heated and ventilated leather-trimmed front captain's chairs
- Power-Adjustable Pedals with memory settings
- Ford Connectivity Package with 5G connectivity and unlimited Wi-Fi hotspot
- Heated and ventilated rear seats for passenger comfort
- Reclining third-row seating with power-folding head restraints
- Google Maps navigation system integrated with Ford Digital Experience
- SecuriCode keyless entry illuminated keypad
- Wireless charging pad for convenient device power

This Platinum model arrives finished in striking black exterior paint, commanding attention from every angle. The meticulously designed Stealth Appearance Package features black EXPEDITION lettering, carbon black front fascia, ebony-painted grille, and illuminated rear spoiler creating a sophisticated, cohesive aesthetic that separates this SUV from the standard models.

The interior welcomes you with premium materials and thoughtful engineering. Heated and ventilated leather captain's chairs in the front row pair with power-adjustable seating and memory functions, allowing each driver to personalize their position instantly. The genuine wood dashboard and door panel inserts add warmth and elegance, while the heated steering wheel ensures comfort during cold weather drives. With three distinct seating rows including reclining third-row seats with power-folding head restraints this Expedition accommodates up to eight passengers with care and consideration for every occupant.

Technology seamlessly integrates throughout the cabin. The B&O Play Unleashed audio system delivers premium sound through 22 speakers with a dedicated subwoofer, while B&O Beosonic customization lets you choose from four distinct sound spaces and five pre-set modes to match your mood. Wireless charging keeps your devices powered, and the Ford Connectivity Package with 5G compatibility and unlimited Wi-Fi hotspot keeps you connected across your entire journey. Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility ensure your smartphone integrates naturally with the vehicle's operations.

Performance and capability define your driving experience. The 3.5L V6 EcoBoost High Output engine delivers responsive power paired with a 10-speed automatic transmission and 4WD capability. The heavy-duty trailer tow system with integrated trailer brake control makes hauling straightforward and controlled. Inside, Ford Co-Pilot360 Active 2.0 provides advanced driver assistance features, while the comprehensive suspension system and electronic stability control work together to maintain confidence on any road surface.

This 2027 Ford Expedition Platinum represents a thoughtful investment in premium full-size SUV ownership delivering commanding presence, refined comfort, advanced technology, and genuine capability for those who refuse to compromise. Contact our showroom today to schedule your test drive and experience firsthand what sets this Expedition apart.

description:
This 2020 Chevrolet Corvette Stingray commands attention in Elkhart Lake Blue Metallic, its dramatic mid-engine styling backed up by genuine performance credentials. Power comes from the all-new 6.2L LT2 V8, rated at 495 horsepower and 470 lb-ft of torque thanks to the equipped performance exhaust with stainless-steel tips, paired exclusively with Chevrolet's quick-shifting 8-speed dual-clutch transmission and rear-wheel drive. This example is further sharpened by the Z51 Performance Package, which adds performance brakes, a firmer suspension tune, a Z51 rear spoiler, a performance rear axle ratio, an electronic limited-slip differential, and a heavy-duty cooling system built for serious driving, all riding on staggered 19x8.5-inch front and 20x11-inch rear wheels finished in Bright Silver. EPA estimates land at 15 city and 27 highway MPG. This Stingray's credentials go beyond the spec sheet, too: the C8 generation swept some of the industry's most prestigious honors, including Car and Driver's 10Best, Motor Trend's Car of the Year, Ward's 10 Best Engines and Propulsion Systems, NACTOY's 2020 North American Car of the Year, and a spot on KBB.com's 10 Favorite New-for-2020 Cars list. It also comes with a Clean CARFAX.

With just over 8,000 miles on the odometer, this one-owner vehicle presents a nearly new ownership opportunity backed by a clean CARFAX report free of accidents.

The heart of this Ranger is its EcoBoost 2.3L turbocharged four-cylinder engine paired with a 10-speed automatic transmission and 4WD. This combination delivers responsive performance while achieving 20 city and 24 highway MPG, balancing efficiency with the power you need for work or adventure. The transmission shifts smoothly through a wide gear range, adapting to various driving conditions with precision.

The FX4 Off-Road Package equips this truck for challenging terrain with genuine off-road engineering. The selectable drive modes, mud/ruts and sand settings, and electronic-locking rear differential give you command over difficult surfaces. Off-road tuned shocks absorb impacts effectively, while the exposed steel bash plate and protective shields guard critical components during aggressive driving.

The XLT cabin combines comfort with functionality. Premium cloth front bucket seats with a center armrest provide support during long drives, while the telescoping steering wheel and tilt adjustment ensure proper positioning for any driver. SYNC 4A with connected navigation keeps you informed and on course, complemented by SiriusXM satellite radio and steering wheel audio controls for seamless entertainment management.

Visibility and safety receive appropriate attention throughout this design. Auto high-beam headlights adjust automatically to oncoming traffic, front fog lights cut through poor conditions, and the auto-dimming rear-view mirror reduces glare during evening drives. Electronic stability control, traction control, four-wheel disc brakes with ABS, and a comprehensive airbag system work together to protect occupants.

The exterior styling reflects the truck's purposeful character. Gray-painted front fascia, rear bumper, center bar, grille surround, and wheel lip molding create a cohesive appearance. The 17 gray-painted aluminum wheels and FX4 Off-Road Box Decal signal serious capability to discerning buyers.

This one-owner, accident-free Ranger represents a significant opportunity for buyers who value quality, capability, and a truck ready for both daily duty and weekend exploration.
